release_blockers.title: Final root release and actual normal-closure input pins are pending
release_blockers.finding: The provided template is disabled and contains pending reader/terminal/closure hashes and null byte lengths. No actual root authorization or actual closed bytes were read or certified. Release requires independent custody of the finalized release, exact reviewed source, fixed-path normal terminal, CLOSURE and entire PAIR_RESULTS, plus confirmed successful prior supervisor CLI completion.

release_blockers.title: Ten scalar cases do not qualify production main or file-pin guards
release_blockers.finding: Qualification calls assemble and render on fabricated dictionaries only. Production path confinement, file pins, source custody, normal-terminal/closure/pair binding, second reads, output creation and successful final CLI return remain unexecuted. Independent syntax and runtime validity were not checked in this source-only review.

nonblocking_guard_limits.title: Complete-diagnostic claim relies on producer for some fields
nonblocking_guard_limits.finding: assemble requires member BCE length, member/route Hits and several coverage fields, but never accesses VALID.served_balanced_BCE or each route served_balanced_BCE. A source-level deletion trace of those fields would pass assemble/render if all other checked fields stayed valid, despite all_planned_diagnostics_retained=True. Actual authenticated diagnostic source emits them; changed final bytes must fail final trusted pins. This is not an independently complete pair-schema validator.

nonblocking_guard_limits.title: Count and sufficient-total consistency guards are partial
nonblocking_guard_limits.finding: Reader checks fixed queries, all-query denominator, aggregate slot conservation and bit total slots. It does not independently enforce nonnegative integral per-batch/stratum/bit counts, has_synthetic_removal + no_synthetic_removal = active_queries, cn0 + has_common = queries, each bit count versus its source label count, or all-stratum spread sum versus global spread sum. The fabricated fixture itself has all-stratum spread totals that differ from the global spread total. A matched pinned producer supplies the stronger invariants.

nonblocking_guard_limits.title: Root release is the trust anchor; authorization reference is not validated
nonblocking_guard_limits.finding: Reader checks schema/execution_enabled and uses release-supplied source and input pins. It neither requires root_authorization_reference nor verifies release_raw against an independently supplied expected hash/signature. Path confinement and a self-consistent hash bundle establish custody, not authority. Final root review must authenticate the release externally. If the reader is intended to enforce reference presence itself, add that guard in a new sealed version.

assessments.arithmetic: Correct sum-over-sum weighting for bit marginals, query strata, all-query entropy/spread and active-query responsibilities; member main loss mean is correct because all 17 batches have equal 65536-query coverage; primary J-F fraction difference is scaled by 100 to percentage points.
assessments.missing_partial_reordered_inputs: Missing checked keys fail; exact J/F and route/stratum sets,17 batches,34 support digests and native counts reject many partial inputs. Dictionary key order is irrelevant. Batch sums are order invariant mathematically; floating accumulation may vary with order. Missing unaccessed fields or jointly reordered/duplicated diagnostics are not fully schema-checked, but any byte change is rejected against externally trusted final pins. No reordered or file-level fabricated cases were run.
assessments.completion_authority: Reader checks fixed normal closure terminal status/child exit/signal/caps/custody/capture/TEST flags, terminal closure pin equality, closed fixed-family work counts, terminal owned pair receipt and full pair pin. Bound supervisor source checks predecessors under normal supervision and closure artifacts before emitting COMPLETE. Reader trusts those pinned assertions instead of re-reading datasets/models or every predecessor.
assessments.output_completeness: Successful CLI writes ANALYSIS.json,REPORT.md and COMPLETE_PAIR_RESULTS.json. Both selections and full VALID dictionaries are retained; both positive/negative aggregates cover all fixed strata/marginals/components/responsibilities; entire decoded pair retains batch-level diagnostics. COMPLETE_PAIR_RESULTS is a semantic reserialization, not an exact byte copy. Native member loss denominator17 is in code and raw batch cardinality; returned mean lacks a separate denominator field.
assessments.cost_scope: Preclosure bound stage ledgers, closure own inclusive accounting and entire normal terminal are retained. Numerical/full-graph qualification and listed prior failures are in bound preclosure costs. Counts3400/200/206 are scientific-fit/selection/validation counts, not total paid optimization or validation across qualification. Overlapping driver/supervisor times are not summed. Unlisted interruptions, unknown unclosed time and write tails are not certified.
assessments.interpretation: Source-observation scope is explicit. Teacher is complete TRAIN membership; zeros are unobserved TRAIN, not verified latent nonlinks. Negative/null primary is not rescued by reconstruction; positive is a descriptive development screen requiring replication/heldout work. No single-seed interval,p-value,heldout,acceptance or general-superiority claim is made.

review_limits.review_method: Read exact source and source metadata; local independent stdlib SHA256/length verification only. Initial repository filename-only inventory was broader than the target; no outcome contents were inspected.
review_limits.unverified: Authorized host/path/interpreter behavior, actual finalized release bytes, actual closure/supervisor/PAIR_RESULTS bytes, asynchronous filesystem mutation, runtime output completion and final output hashes.

publication_limits: Second input/source/release checks precede writing, but are not an atomic input snapshot. Sequential exclusive output writes can leave partial files on failure. There is no durable reader completion seal or output-byte receipt. Promote only after CLI success and independent complete output custody; reader_observed_wall_seconds stops before final report writes and final_write_tail_measured is false.
